programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Ohio, police discover a young woman lying near railroad tracks - a railroad spike plunged in her head. She dies a few hours later. Without any clues to her whereabouts, investigators turn to psychic Kathlyn Rhea for guidance.
